learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose 2000 against 4000 and 8000; locked it in.
observations.exploration: 1000 sample showed ±3.1 points,95/100 inside band. Double people to2000 gave ±2.2,97/100; second double4000 gave ±1.5,95/100. End on slider8000 gave ±1.1,97/100; doubling disabled.
observations.reveal: Corrected to4000; connected tested2000 and4000 margins to square-root sample-size relation. Explicitly excludes refusal/nonresponse and biased list errors.
observations.visual: Actual1257 ×936 dark screenshots inspected. Dot cloud narrows within band and dashed prior bands. In reveal screenshot a horizontal scrollbar lies across lower metric cards, partially obscuring their numbers; upper labels and reveal remain readable.

prediction.reason: Plausible doubling versus quadrupling choices test linear expectation.

interaction.reason: Multiple sample sizes visibly narrow spread and margin.

payoff.reason: Uses actual contrasts and states sampling-only limit.

clarity.reason: Sequence usable but horizontal scrollbar partly covers metric cards in reveal view.

transfer.reason: Reusable sample-cost rule and limits, no concrete new application.
transfer.evidence: Half error costs four times people.

accessibility.reason: One slider endpoint key insufficient audit.
accessibility.evidence: End worked; focus,contrast,phone,zoom and motion unknown.

surprise.reason: Committed doubling estimate fails to halve margin.

visualExplanation.reason: Dot spread and comparison bands show diminishing precision gains.
visualExplanation.evidence: Narrow cloud inside dashed prior bands.

playfulness.reason: Doubling and endpoint changes permit successive comparisons.

depth.reason: Square-root return and sampling-bias limitation linked.

complexity.reason: Relates sample scaling to uncertainty width and error scope.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Two linked relations: quadrupling size halves random margin; bias lies outside it.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Moderate: horizontal scrollbar partly overlaps counters.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: moderate: sampling margin and square-root scaling.

whyCool: Two doublings visibly shrink the band by half while one doubling falls short.
caveat: One true-support level; no nonresponse or bias experiment and a scrollbar obscures part of metric cards.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
